notes.title: Warmth Steam Awards
notes.content:
Dear Warmth followers,

We are happy to announce that Warmth is a candidate for the Steam 2022 Awards: Labor of Love category!
We hope some of you would be willing to help us out in this competition by voting for Warmth and/or sharing this message with your friends!

Kind regards and stay warm during these winter months,
Spreadable Fruit Games

notes.title: New levels released!
notes.content:
Dear (future) Warmth players,

To help everyone get through these trying times we have made 16 new levels to enjoy from the safety of your home!

These levels are freely available to all owners of the game, and the purchase price for future owners also won't be raised (so it's a great time to pickup the game if you haven't already)!

Kind regards and much warmth to you all,
Spreadable Fruit Games
